## Highlights

**Kraftverk 0.2.0** is the expansive platform phase: crate consolidation, KraftBench v2, richer optimizer sessions/profiles/receipts, CLI expansions, desktop engineering instrument, SDK facade, and CI/Pages/Release automation.

> Prefer **[v0.2.1](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/tag/v0.2.1)** for AMD-exclusive hardware enforcement (`amd-only-v1`) and exit codes 20ΓÇô25. This tag predates that gate.

## What's included

- **CLI** (`kraftverk` / `kraftverk.exe`) ΓÇö `doctor`, `capabilities`, `report`, `chase`, `analyze`, `receipt`, `profile *`, HTML/JSON reports
- **Desktop** (`kraftverk-desktop` / `kraftverk-desktop.exe`) ΓÇö local web UI + Safety Center
- **KraftBench v2** ΓÇö CPU scaling, compile proxy, responsiveness index, sustained windows (`--sustained`)
- **Optimizer** ΓÇö goals, constraints, sessions/resume, lineage, insights, objectives, search plugins, evidence receipts
- **Telemetry** ΓÇö environmental noise model (no fabricated temps/power)
- **SDK** facade and workspace consolidation (Γëñ10 crates)
- Packaged archives include `README.md`, `LICENSE`, and `CHANGELOG.md`

## Install

### Windows (x86_64)

1. Download [`kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.0/kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip)
2. Verify checksum against [`kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.0/kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256):

   ```powershell
   Get-FileHash .\kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip -Algorithm SHA256
   Get-Content .\kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip.sha256
   ```

3. Extract and run:

   ```powershell
   .\kraftverk.exe inspect
   .\kraftverk-desktop.exe
   ```

### Linux (x86_64)

1. Download [`kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.0/kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz)
2. Verify checksum against [`kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256`](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/download/v0.2.0/kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256):

   ```bash
   sha256sum -c kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256
   ```

3. Extract and run:

   ```bash
   tar xzf kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
   cd kraftverk-v0.2.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
   chmod +x kraftverk kraftverk-desktop
   ./kraftverk inspect
   ./kraftverk-desktop
   ```

### Build from source

```bash
cargo build --release -p kraftverk-cli
cargo build --release -p kraftverk-desktop
```

## Quick start

```bash
kraftverk inspect
kraftverk baseline
kraftverk optimize --mode safe
kraftverk status
kraftverk report --format html
kraftverk restore --baseline
```

## Hardware requirements

Official binaries target **x86_64 Windows** and **x86_64 Linux**.

This release **does not** include the `amd-only-v1` hard gate introduced in **v0.2.1**. For AMD-only enforcement, exit codes 20ΓÇô25, and inspect-only `compatibility` / `hardware` / `amd` commands, use [v0.2.1](https://github.com/theworker02/kraftverk/releases/tag/v0.2.1).

Docs (current): [Hardware support](https://theworker02.github.io/kraftverk/docs/hardware-support.html)

## Known limitations (0.2.0)

- GPU benchmarks unsupported (no vendor backend)
- Temperature / power sensors unavailable portably
- Privileged agent remains a scaffold
- Desktop is a **local web UI** (Tauri packaging later)
- ╬╡-greedy / Bayesian search plugins listed but not implemented
- No AMD hardware eligibility gate yet (added in v0.2.1)
